decisions.reason: The digital anamnesis and consent app is the flagship product line, close to the core offer and central to the firm's digital direction, so keeping the option open costs little and its strategic value is still growing.
Remote screen sharing support costs little to maintain, complements the firm's support operations, and became more valuable after the pandemic pushed support toward remote channels.

The practice analytics dashboard builds on the firm's practice data and fits the move toward efficiently managed practices; its value is still uncertain but it is cheap to keep as a modular extension.
The complete practice bundle mainly packages existing offerings for new practices, so keeping it costs little, though it may be restructured as the product range changes.

The job and practice listing portal is distant from the core software business and its value is unproven, but as a low-cost web service that draws dental professionals to the firm's ecosystem it remains worth holding a little longer before abandoning it.
